name: An Unholy Alliance
summary: Varimathras sends you to confront Ambassador Malcin outside Razorfen Downs. The envoy's presence may explain the strange strength and Plague signs among some quilboar.

sections.title: The Envoy
sections.body: Varimathras waits in the Undercity with a charge for you. Outside Razorfen Downs, Ambassador Malcin's presence may explain why some quilboar have grown powerful and show signs of the Plague. Varimathras calls the envoy's mission a failure in the Lich King's eyes, and demands his death.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find Malcin?
faq.answer: Varimathras in the Undercity asks you to find Ambassador Malcin outside Razorfen Downs.
Ambassador Malcin is an envoy outside Razorfen Downs whose presence may explain the strange strength and Plague signs among some quilboar.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras want Malcin dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras says Malcin's mission is a failure in the Lich King's eyes.

faq.q: What is happening to the quilboar?
faq.answer: Some quilboar have grown unusually powerful and show signs of the Plague in their own way.
Varimathras says Ambassador Malcin is outside Razorfen Downs.

faq.q: What does Varimathras ask me to bring back?
faq.answer: Varimathras asks you to bring him Ambassador Malcin's head in the Undercity.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Unholy Alliance
